A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ALI-CFM research work, including complete Appendices A–D. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the methods, equations, proofs, figures, tables and supplementary material.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic-knot, cell-tracking, single-cell and spatial-transcriptomics experiments in Sections 4.1–4.4, with additional experimental results and ablations in Appendix D.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experiments in Sections 4.1–4.4 and the supplementary experiments and ablations in Appendix D.

M1.justification: The neural interpolants, adversarial objective, three regularisers, coupling choices and subsequent flow-matching procedure are unchanged, including Algorithms 1–2 and the implementation described in Appendix D.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic knot, U373 cell tracking, embryoid-body, CITE-seq, Multiome and breast-cancer spatial-transcriptomics data, with unchanged tasks and test scenarios.

E2.justification: The experiment-specific CFM, MFM and MMFM comparator sets are unchanged, including independent/OT coupling variants and time-dependent/time-independent metric variants. No comparator is added or removed from a corresponding comparison.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices B–D retain the same sample counts, preprocessing, PCA dimensions, held-out marginal evaluations, metrics, model configurations, training budgets and integration settings.

E4.justification: The marginal-count and metric analyses in Appendix D.1, coupling comparison in D.2, and regulariser/weight ablations in D.3.1 are unchanged. Figures 8–11 and Tables 4–6 contain the same supporting evidence.

E5.justification: Repeated-run and uncertainty reporting are identical. Both versions state that Table 1 averages five independent runs and retain the same uncertainty displays, without additional statistical procedures or seed information.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–6 and the experimental figures are unchanged. For example, Table 3 reports OT-ALI-CFM EMD of 98.91 ± 2.03 in both versions; numerical rankings and qualitative findings are retained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, equations and uniqueness Theorems 2.1–2.2 are identical, including both proofs in Appendix A and the mathematical specifications in the other appendices.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same contributions and claims about adversarial interpolants, uniqueness, cell-tracking and spatial-transcriptomics performance, and competitive single-cell trajectory inference.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning smoothness, baseline failures, distribution versus pointwise matching, adversarial-training difficulties and regularisation remain unchanged. No applicability boundary or substantive limitation is added or revised.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, alignment and normalisation instructions, hardware/runtime disclosures, and code/data links are unchanged. The updated arXiv self-link only identifies the later document version.

R1.justification: The cited works and reference list are unchanged, as is Section 3's positioning relative to previous flow-matching, neural-interpolant and spline-based methods.

P1.justification: The displayed author name changes from Nikolay Malkin to Esmeralda S. Whitammer, and the acknowledgements replace NM with ESW. The arXiv version/date markings also change. Scientific prose and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–11 and Tables 1–6 retain identical content, captions, formatting and placement. The author and version-label text edits do not introduce a figure, table or structural layout revision.

improvement.justification: The changes are confined to the displayed author name, corresponding acknowledgement initials and version/date markings. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, proofs, reproducibility information and readability are unchanged, providing no evidence of a meaningful overall quality gain or decline.
